reuse.why: All providers share the new link guards and Fintegra uses findOrCreateBank and syncAccount, but local unlinking and provider orchestration remain copied.

duplication.why: The diff duplicates account-link orchestration, transaction downloading, Akahu's starting-balance calculation, and unlinkAccount's field-clearing block.

placement.why: Provider integration follows the existing module boundaries, although destructive unlinking is buried inside a function named as a validation guard.

scope.why: The changes stay focused on the requested linking rules, replacement option, Fintegra integration, and accompanying tests.

maintainability.why: Centralized guards help maintain the linking rules, but duplicated provider workflows and unlink state transitions create multiple places to maintain.

bypasses_abstraction.where: app.ts: ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked independently implements unlinkAccount's local field clearing; extracting that operation would allow reuse without invoking provider cleanup.

disguised_duplication.where: linkFintegraAccount condenses the existing provider-link workflow, and downloadFintegraTransactions reshapes the existing authenticated transaction-download workflow without sharing it.

abstraction_drift.where: ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked gains replaceExistingLink and a replacement branch that mutates another account, expanding a validation helper into a state-changing operation; all six linking handlers still use the shared guards.
